CreateAccessGrant.name: CreateAccessGrant
CreateAccessGrant.documentation:
Creates an AccessGrant that authorizes a principal to perform a set of actions on resources in a space.

Optionally narrow the grant with scoped actions that limit it to specific resources and fields. Use ListAccessGrants and GetAccessGrant to retrieve grants, and DeleteAccessGrant to remove them.

CreateAccessProfile.name: CreateAccessProfile
CreateAccessProfile.documentation:
Creates an access profile in a space.

Use GetAccessProfile and ListAccessProfiles to retrieve profiles, and UpdateAccessProfile to modify one.

CreateAlert.name: CreateAlert
CreateAlert.documentation:
Creates a new alert within a space.

Use GetAlert and ListAlerts to retrieve alerts, UpdateAlert to modify one, and DeleteAlert to remove it.

CreateDomain.name: CreateDomain
CreateDomain.documentation:
Creates a domain with identity provider configuration.

Use GetDomain to retrieve the domain, UpdateDomain to change its configuration, and CreateSpace to add spaces within it.

CreateDomainAccessGrantForOrganization.name: CreateDomainAccessGrantForOrganization
CreateDomainAccessGrantForOrganization.documentation: Creates an AccessGrant that authorizes a principal to administer an organization domain.

CreateDomainForOrganization.name: CreateDomainForOrganization
CreateDomainForOrganization.documentation: Creates an organization-scoped domain for the caller's AWS Organization. Only the organization's management account can call this operation.

CreateIntegration.name: CreateIntegration
CreateIntegration.documentation: Creates an integration with a third-party provider. Returns the integration identifier and its initial status; when the provider requires interactive consent, an authorization URL is returned for the user to complete setup.

CreateOmniDashboard.name: CreateOmniDashboard
CreateOmniDashboard.documentation:
Creates a new dashboard within a space.

Use GetOmniDashboard and ListOmniDashboards to retrieve dashboards, UpdateOmniDashboard to modify one, and DeleteOmniDashboard to remove it.

CreateOneTimeDeepLinkCode.name: CreateOneTimeDeepLinkCode
CreateOneTimeDeepLinkCode.documentation:
Generates a one-time code for deep-link authentication.

Direct the user's browser to the returned deepLinkUrl before it expires. The code is exchanged for an authenticated, domain-scoped session and can be used only once.

CreateSpace.name: CreateSpace
CreateSpace.documentation:
Creates a space in a domain.

Use GetSpace to retrieve the space, ListSpaces to enumerate spaces, UpdateSpace to modify it, and DeleteSpace to remove it.

CreateView.name: CreateView
CreateView.documentation:
Creates a new SQL view.

A view is a named, reusable SQL query that can be referenced from telemetry queries. View names must be unique within the account and region. Only USER views can be created — MANAGED views are provisioned by AWS.

DeleteAccessGrant.name: DeleteAccessGrant
DeleteAccessGrant.documentation:
Removes an existing AccessGrant, revoking the access it granted.

A service-managed grant cannot be deleted.

DeleteAccessProfile.name: DeleteAccessProfile
DeleteAccessProfile.documentation:
Removes an access profile.

An access profile cannot be deleted while access grants reference it.

DeleteAlert.name: DeleteAlert
DeleteAlert.documentation:
Deletes an alert by its identifier.

Idempotent: deleting an alert that has already been removed succeeds without error.

DeleteDomain.name: DeleteDomain
DeleteDomain.documentation:
Removes a domain and all of its resources. Call this operation in the Region where the domain was created.

A domain cannot be deleted while it contains spaces.

DeleteDomainAccessGrantForOrganization.name: DeleteDomainAccessGrantForOrganization
DeleteDomainAccessGrantForOrganization.documentation:
Removes an existing organization access grant, revoking the access it granted.

A service-managed grant cannot be deleted.

DeleteDomainForOrganization.name: DeleteDomainForOrganization
DeleteDomainForOrganization.documentation:
Removes an organization domain and all of its resources. Call this operation in the Region where the domain was created.

A domain cannot be deleted while it contains spaces.

DeleteIntegration.name: DeleteIntegration
DeleteIntegration.documentation: Deletes an integration. Returns the resulting status.

DeleteSpace.name: DeleteSpace
DeleteSpace.documentation: Removes a space and all of its resources.

DeleteView.name: DeleteView
DeleteView.documentation:
Deletes the specified view.

Queries that reference the view fail after it is deleted. Managed views cannot be deleted.

GetAccessGrant.name: GetAccessGrant
GetAccessGrant.documentation: Retrieves the full detail of a single AccessGrant by ID.

GetAccessProfile.name: GetAccessProfile
GetAccessProfile.documentation:
Retrieves an access profile by ID.

The response indicates whether the calling principal is currently allowed to assume the profile.

GetAlert.name: GetAlert
GetAlert.documentation:
Retrieves a single alert by its identifier.

Use ListAlerts to enumerate alerts in the space.

GetContextGraph.name: GetContextGraph
GetContextGraph.documentation:
Queries the context graph with filtering, traversal, and pagination support.

Pagination note: nodes and edges are returned together as a coherent subgraph. Pagination cursors advance over nodes (the primary collection); each page includes all edges connecting nodes within that page. Callers should treat nodes as the paginated collection and edges as supplementary relationship data attached to those nodes.

GetDomain.name: GetDomain
GetDomain.documentation: Retrieves the details of a domain by ID.

GetDomainAccessGrantForOrganization.name: GetDomainAccessGrantForOrganization
GetDomainAccessGrantForOrganization.documentation: Retrieves the full detail of a single organization access grant by ID.

GetDomainForOrganization.name: GetDomainForOrganization
GetDomainForOrganization.documentation: Retrieves the details of an organization domain by ID.

GetIntegration.name: GetIntegration
GetIntegration.documentation: Returns the details of a single integration, identified by its identifier, Amazon Resource Name, or name.

GetIntelligenceConfiguration.name: GetIntelligenceConfiguration
GetIntelligenceConfiguration.documentation: Retrieves the intelligence configuration for the calling account. Account is identified via FAS (caller identity). Returns the default configuration if none exists yet.

GetOmniDashboard.name: GetOmniDashboard
GetOmniDashboard.documentation: Retrieves a dashboard by ID within a space.

GetSpace.name: GetSpace
GetSpace.documentation: Retrieves the details of a space by ID.

GetSpaceCredentialsForOrganization.name: GetSpaceCredentialsForOrganization
GetSpaceCredentialsForOrganization.documentation:
Returns temporary credentials for a space in an organization member account. The credentials are valid for one hour.

The caller must be the organization's management account or a delegated administrator with access to the target space. The target account must be an active member of the same organization as the domain, and the space must already exist.

GetTelemetryQueryResults.name: GetTelemetryQueryResults
GetTelemetryQueryResults.documentation: Returns the results for the specified query.

GetView.name: GetView
GetView.documentation: Returns the definition and metadata of the specified view.

ListAccessGrants.name: ListAccessGrants
ListAccessGrants.documentation: Returns AccessGrants, with optional filtering by domain, space, principal, or permission. A grant is returned only when it matches every filter supplied. With no filters, returns the grants for the current account and Region.

ListAccessProfiles.name: ListAccessProfiles
ListAccessProfiles.documentation: Returns the access profiles in a space.

ListAlerts.name: ListAlerts
ListAlerts.documentation:
Lists alerts within a space, optionally filtered by exact name(s), a single name prefix, or exact alertId(s), with pagination.

Use GetAlert to retrieve a single alert's full detail.

ListDomainAccessGrantsForOrganization.name: ListDomainAccessGrantsForOrganization
ListDomainAccessGrantsForOrganization.documentation: Returns organization-level domain access grants, with optional filtering by domain, principal, or permission. A grant is returned only when it matches every filter supplied. With no filters, returns the grants for the caller's organization.

ListDomains.name: ListDomains
ListDomains.documentation: Returns the caller's domains: the account-scoped domain and the organization-scoped domain, if either exists. At most two domains are returned.

ListIntegrations.name: ListIntegrations
ListIntegrations.documentation: Lists the integrations in the account, optionally filtered by type, status, or name. Results are paginated.

ListOmniDashboards.name: ListOmniDashboards
ListOmniDashboards.documentation: Returns the dashboards in a space, optionally filtered by name prefix.

ListSpaces.name: ListSpaces
ListSpaces.documentation: Returns the spaces in the account, optionally filtered by domain.

ListSpacesForOrganization.name: ListSpacesForOrganization
ListSpacesForOrganization.documentation: Returns the spaces across all member accounts in the organization.

ListTelemetryFields.name: ListTelemetryFields
ListTelemetryFields.documentation:
Lists fields available for telemetry queries.

Returns a list of fields included in the specified dataset, granular to telemetry type. Returned field names reflect the exact stored casing and are case-sensitive when referenced in query expressions; the query engine does not normalize identifier case.

ListTelemetryQuerySessions.name: ListTelemetryQuerySessions
ListTelemetryQuerySessions.documentation:
Lists telemetry query sessions.

Returns a list of telemetry query sessions owned by the caller.

ListViews.name: ListViews
ListViews.documentation:
Lists the views in the caller's account and region.

Returns a summary for each view, optionally filtered by view type. View definitions are not included — use GetView to retrieve them.

PutIntelligenceConfiguration.name: PutIntelligenceConfiguration
PutIntelligenceConfiguration.documentation: Creates or updates the intelligence configuration for the calling account. Account is identified via FAS (caller identity).

SearchPrincipals.name: SearchPrincipals
SearchPrincipals.documentation:
Searches Identity Center for users and groups in a domain. The domain must be configured with Identity Center.

To grant access to a result, pass its principalId to CreateAccessGrant with a principalType of IDC_USER for a user or IDC_GROUP for a group.

StartTelemetryQuery.name: StartTelemetryQuery
StartTelemetryQuery.documentation:
Starts a telemetry query within a session.

Submits the provided query string for execution in the specified session. Use GetTelemetryQueryResults to poll for results and check query status.

StartTelemetryQuerySession.name: StartTelemetryQuerySession
StartTelemetryQuerySession.documentation:
Starts a new telemetry query session.

A session provides a logical grouping for one or more telemetry queries. The returned session ID is required when starting queries via StartTelemetryQuery.

StopTelemetryQuerySession.name: StopTelemetryQuerySession
StopTelemetryQuerySession.documentation:
Stops a telemetry query session.

Terminates the specified session. After a session is stopped it cannot be reused.

UpdateAccessProfile.name: UpdateAccessProfile
UpdateAccessProfile.documentation:
Updates the name or description of an access profile.

Only the provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left unchanged.

UpdateAlert.name: UpdateAlert
UpdateAlert.documentation:
Updates an existing alert.

Only non-null fields overwrite existing values.

UpdateDomain.name: UpdateDomain
UpdateDomain.documentation:
Updates a domain's name or identity provider configuration.

Only the provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left unchanged. Renaming a domain also changes the endpoint URLs derived from its name.

UpdateDomainForOrganization.name: UpdateDomainForOrganization
UpdateDomainForOrganization.documentation:
Updates an organization domain's name or identity provider configuration. Call this operation in the Region where the domain was created.

Only the provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left unchanged. Renaming a domain also changes the endpoint URLs derived from its name.

UpdateIntegration.name: UpdateIntegration
UpdateIntegration.documentation: Updates an existing integration, identified by its id, ARN, or name. Only the fields you provide are changed.

UpdateOmniDashboard.name: UpdateOmniDashboard
UpdateOmniDashboard.documentation:
Updates an existing dashboard within a space.

Only the provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left unchanged.

UpdateSpace.name: UpdateSpace
UpdateSpace.documentation:
Updates a space.

Only the provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left unchanged.

UpdateView.name: UpdateView
UpdateView.documentation:
Updates an existing view's definition and/or description.

Only the fields you provide are changed. Managed views cannot be updated.

AccessDeniedException.documentation: The caller is not authorized to perform this action.

AccessGrant.documentation: Full AccessGrant structure returned by API operations.

principalId.documentation: The ID of the principal receiving the grant.

principalAttributes.documentation: Attribute conditions for attribute-based access. When provided, the grant targets any principal matching all specified conditions. Supported only for IDC_USER principals.

AccessGrantPrincipal.documentation: The principal receiving the grant. Specify principalId, principalAttributes, or both.

key.documentation: The Identity Center user attribute to match on. One of userName, active, userStatus, displayName, email, name.givenName, name.familyName, enterprise.department, enterprise.division, enterprise.organization, enterprise.costCenter, or enterprise.employeeNumber. Each key may appear only once per grant.

AccessGrantPrincipalAttribute.documentation: A single attribute condition used to match principals for attribute-based access.

grantId.documentation: The unique ID of the access grant.

grantArn.documentation: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the access grant.

name.documentation: A name that identifies the access grant.

domainId.documentation: The ID of the domain the grant belongs to.

spaceId.documentation: The space this grant applies to. Domain-scoped grants are returned by ListDomainAccessGrantsForOrganization instead.

AccessGrantSummary.documentation: Summary of an AccessGrant. Call GetAccessGrant for the full grant.

profileId.documentation: The unique ID of the access profile.

spaceId.documentation: The ID of the space the profile belongs to.

name.documentation: A name that identifies the access profile.

description.documentation: An optional description of the access profile.

createdAt.documentation: The timestamp when the access profile was created.

updatedAt.documentation: The timestamp when the access profile was last updated.

assumeStatus.documentation: The calling principal's authorization to assume this access profile.

AccessProfileName.documentation: A name that identifies an access profile. Must be 1-256 characters: letters, numbers, spaces, and the characters _ . : / = + @ -

profileId.documentation: The unique ID of the access profile.

name.documentation: A name that identifies the access profile.

description.documentation: An optional description of the access profile.

AccessProfileSummary.documentation: Summary of an access profile. Call GetAccessProfile for the full profile.

name.documentation: The name of the alert.

alertId.documentation: The stable alert identifier (see {@link AlertId}), minted on create and immutable across updates. Use it (not {@code name}) to address the alert on GetAlert/UpdateAlert/DeleteAlert; it is also the ARN's resource id.

accountId.documentation: The AWS account ID that owns the alert.

spaceId.documentation: The ID of the space the alert belongs to.

profileId.documentation: The ID of the access profile associated with the alert.

rule.documentation: The rule that defines how the alert is evaluated.

state.documentation:
Live evaluation state (read-only, system-managed). Populated by GetAlert. ListAlerts reports state on AlertSummary instead, where it stays required.

Absent on CreateAlert: a newly created alert has never been evaluated, so any state reported there would be a default rather than an observation. Call GetAlert for live state. Not @required for that reason — GetAlert always populates it.

contributorSummary is nested inside this member, so it too is absent on CreateAlert.

createdAt.documentation: The timestamp when the alert was created.

updatedAt.documentation: The timestamp when the alert was last updated.

alertArn.documentation: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the alert.

Alert.documentation: Full alert entity, returned by both CreateAlert and GetAlert. A create and a read of the same alert describe it identically except for {@code state}, which only the read paths populate. UpdateAlert returns an empty response.

thresholdMode.documentation: How the threshold is applied to query results.

thresholdField.documentation: The field the threshold is evaluated against.

comparator.documentation: The comparison operator applied to the threshold.

warningThreshold.documentation: The value at which the alert enters the WARNING state.

criticalThreshold.documentation: The value at which the alert enters the CRITICAL state.

AlertCondition.documentation:
The condition that determines when the alert fires.

On UpdateAlert a supplied condition is replaced whole, not merged: an omitted {@code warningThreshold} or {@code criticalThreshold} removes that tier, and an omitted {@code thresholdField} clears it. A condition must keep at least one tier. {@code thresholdMode} and {@code comparator} are optional at the Smithy level (so a single-tier condition is expressible) but are required whenever a threshold is present; enforced by the service-side validator.

pendingDurationSeconds.documentation: The duration a breach must persist before the alert fires, in seconds.

recoveryDurationSeconds.documentation: The duration a recovery must persist before the alert clears, in seconds.

AlertEvaluation.documentation:
Evaluation cadence. {@code intervalSeconds} must be one of {30, 60, 120, 300, 600, 900, 1800, 3600}; {@code pendingDurationSeconds} and {@code recoveryDurationSeconds} must be multiples of {@code intervalSeconds}. A duration of 0 means fire/clear immediately with no delay.

On UpdateAlert a supplied evaluation block is replaced whole, not merged: an omitted {@code pendingDurationSeconds} or {@code recoveryDurationSeconds} is cleared to unset (no such duration), not preserved and not defaulted to 0. {@code intervalSeconds} is required whenever the block is present. All enforced server-side / by the front-door validator.

names.documentation: Filter to alerts whose name exactly matches any entry (OR semantics). Mutually exclusive with {@code namePrefix} and {@code ids}.

namePrefix.documentation: Filter to alerts whose name starts with this prefix. Mutually exclusive with {@code names} and {@code ids}.

ids.documentation: Filter to alerts whose {@link AlertId} exactly matches any entry (OR semantics). Mutually exclusive with {@code names} and {@code namePrefix}.

stateValue.documentation: Filter to alerts currently in any of these states (OR semantics).

notificationsEnabled.documentation: Filter to alerts by whether notifications are enabled.

AlertFilterCriteria.documentation: Filter criteria for ListAlerts. All members are optional; each omitted member is unconstrained. At most one of {@code names}, {@code namePrefix}, {@code ids} may be provided (mutually exclusive; the service rejects more than one). The remaining members combine with AND.

AlertId.documentation:
The stable alert identifier: a 32-character lowercase hex uuid, minted by the backend on create and immutable across updates.

It deliberately carries no name, so that a future rename cannot change an alert's identity and break the ARNs, saved links and IAM policies pointing at it. Use {@code name} to display an alert and {@code alertId} to address one.

AlertIdFilterList.documentation: Exact alertId match list. Members reuse the {@link AlertId} type so the charset/cap stay in sync with it.

AlertNameFilterList.documentation: List of exact alert names to filter by.

AlertRuleQuery.documentation: Query expression and the language it's written in.

AlertSortField.documentation: Field by which alerts can be sorted.

AlertState.documentation: Flat alert state. Severity is folded in: a WARNING/CRITICAL alert reports that state directly. {@code NODATA} indicates the evaluation produced no data (subject to the rule's noData.treatAs handling).

thresholdBreached.documentation: For COUNT_OF_RESULTS alerts, the row count that breached; null for FIELD_VALUE (multi-contributor) alerts.

transitionedAt.documentation: When the alert transitioned to its current state.

contributorSummary.documentation: Counts of contributors currently breaching each severity threshold. Present only when contributor-level tracking is active; absent until the first contributor breaches a {@code WARNING} or {@code CRITICAL} threshold.

data.documentation: Structured detail about why the alert is in its current state.

AlertStateInfo.documentation: Live evaluation state for an alert. Read-only, system-managed.

name.documentation: The name of the alert.

alertId.documentation: The stable alert identifier (see {@link Alert#alertId}). Use it to address the alert; it is also the ARN's resource id.

spaceId.documentation: The ID of the space the alert belongs to.

profileId.documentation: The ID of the access profile associated with the alert.

createdAt.documentation: The timestamp when the alert was created.

updatedAt.documentation: The timestamp when the alert was last updated.

alertArn.documentation: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the alert.

AlertSummary.documentation: Summary representation of an alert used in list responses.

apiKeyValue.documentation: The API key value used to authenticate with the external system.

ApiKeyCredential.documentation: An API key used to authenticate an integration with its external system.

AssumeStatus.documentation: The calling principal's authorization to assume an access profile.

AuthType.documentation: The authentication method that an integration uses to connect to its external system.

ClientToken.documentation: Idempotency token for safe retries. Repeated requests with the same token return the original result instead of creating a duplicate.

conflictType.documentation: The type of conflict that caused the request to fail. Not always present.

resourceId.documentation: The identifier of the resource that is in conflict. Not always present.

resourceType.documentation: The type of the resource that is in conflict. Not always present.

errorCode.documentation: The error code associated with the conflict. Not always present.

ConflictException.documentation: The operation could not be completed because of a conflict with the current state of the resource.

ContextConditionsMap.documentation: Map of context condition keys to lists of allowed values. Used for fine-grained access control on integrations.

ContextGraphAttributeMap.documentation: Attribute map for the unpromoted tail on a context graph node or edge. Holds only the keys that did not land on a typed properties member, so a value is never reported in two places.

warningCount.documentation: Number of contributors currently breaching the warning threshold.

criticalCount.documentation: Number of contributors currently breaching the critical threshold.

ContributorSummary.documentation: Counts of contributors currently breaching each severity threshold.

domainId.documentation: The ID of the domain that contains the space.

spaceId.documentation: The ID of the space to scope the grant to.

name.documentation: A name that identifies the access grant.

permission.documentation: The permission to grant. Exactly one permission is granted per request.

scopedActions.documentation: Groups of actions to allow, each with the resource scopes and conditions that limit those actions.

tags.documentation: The tags to associate with the access grant.

clientToken.documentation: Idempotency token for safe retries. Repeated requests with the same token return the original result instead of creating a duplicate.

accessGrant.documentation: The details of the created access grant.

spaceId.documentation: The unique ID of the space to create the profile in.

name.documentation: A name that identifies the access profile.

description.documentation: An optional description of the access profile.

tags.documentation: The tags to associate with the access profile.

clientToken.documentation: Idempotency token for safe retries. Repeated requests with the same token return the original result instead of creating a duplicate.

spaceId.documentation: The unique ID of the space to create the alert in.

profileId.documentation: The ID of the access profile the alert uses to evaluate its query and execute notifications. The caller supplies it: there is no managed alert profile, and the service does not pick one on the caller's behalf.

name.documentation: Alert name, for display. Max 256 (the AlarmName budget). Not the alert's identity: the backend mints a separate uuid as the {@link AlertId}, so the name need not be unique within a space and addressing an alert never depends on it. UpdateAlert accepts a new name to rename the alert.

rule.documentation: The rule that defines how the alert is evaluated.

notificationsEnabled.documentation: Whether actions (notifications) are enabled for this alert. Defaults to true when omitted.

tags.documentation: The tags to associate with the alert.

notificationRules.documentation: The notification rules that determine when and where notifications are sent.

clientToken.documentation: Idempotency token for safe retries. Retrying with the same token within the idempotency window returns the original alert instead of creating a duplicate.

alertArn.documentation: Deprecated. Use alert.alertArn, which carries the same value. Kept so an existing caller keeps working while it moves to alert.

alert.documentation:
The alert that was created. The same Alert shape GetAlert returns, so a caller need not read the alert back to learn its timestamps or its minted alert id.

{@code alert.state} is absent here — see the state member of Alert. Every other member is populated exactly as GetAlert populates it.

domainId.documentation: The ID of the organization domain to create the grant on.

name.documentation: A name that identifies the access grant.

tags.documentation: The tags to associate with the access grant.

clientToken.documentation: Idempotency token for safe retries. Repeated requests with the same token return the original result instead of creating a duplicate.

accessGrant.documentation: The details of the created organization access grant.

name.documentation: A name that identifies the organization domain. Must be 3-63 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. It must begin and end with a letter or number and cannot contain consecutive hyphens.

identityProviders.documentation: The identity providers to configure for the domain.

domainAccessRoleArn.documentation: The ARN of an IAM role in the management account used for domain access. You must create this role, and its trust policy must allow the service principal to assume it.

tags.documentation: The tags to associate with the domain.

clientToken.documentation: Idempotency token for safe retries. Repeated requests with the same token return the original result instead of creating a duplicate.

organizationDomain.documentation: The details of the created organization domain.

name.documentation: A name that identifies the domain. Must be 3-63 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. It must begin and end with a letter or number and cannot contain consecutive hyphens.

identityProviders.documentation: The identity providers to configure for the domain.

tags.documentation: The tags to associate with the domain.

clientToken.documentation: Idempotency token for safe retries. Repeated requests with the same token return the original result instead of creating a duplicate.

integrationType.documentation: The type of third-party provider to integrate with.

name.documentation: The name for the new integration; unique within the account.

credential.documentation: The credential used to authenticate with the third-party provider.

integrationAttributes.documentation: Provider-specific attributes to associate with the integration.

roleArn.documentation: The Amazon Resource Name of the IAM role assumed to access the integration.

tags.documentation: Tags to apply to the integration at creation time (Tagris tag-on-create).

clientToken.documentation: Idempotency token for safe retries. Retrying with the same token returns the original integration instead of creating a duplicate.

CreateIntegrationInput.documentation: The request for creating an integration with a third-party provider.

integration.documentation: The details of the created integration. This is the same object returned by GetIntegration and UpdateIntegration.

spaceId.documentation: The unique ID of the space to create the dashboard in.

name.documentation: A name that identifies the dashboard.

body.documentation: The dashboard definition, as a JSON document. Maximum 1 MiB.

tags.documentation: The tags to associate with the dashboard.

clientToken.documentation: Idempotency token for safe retries. Repeated requests with the same token return the original result instead of creating a duplicate.

domainId.documentation: The ID of the domain to generate the code for.

ttlSeconds.documentation: How long the code remains valid, in seconds. Defaults to 300.

redirectUrl.documentation: The URL to redirect to after the deep-link code is used. Must be an HTTPS URL in the domain with a path of /auth/callback, and cannot include a query string or fragment. If omitted, no redirect is applied.

deepLinkUrl.documentation: The deep-link URL containing the one-time code.

name.documentation: A name that identifies the space. Must be 3-64 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. It must begin and end with a letter or number and cannot contain consecutive hyphens.

domainId.documentation: The ID of the domain to create the space in.

dataAccessRoleArn.documentation: The ARN of the IAM role used for data access. The role must be in the caller's account.

agentCoreEvaluationRoleArn.documentation: The ARN of the IAM role used by AgentCore online evaluation. Must be in the caller's account. Omit if the space does not use AgentCore online evaluation.

encryptionConfiguration.documentation: How to encrypt the space's data at rest. Omit for service owned encryption, which is equivalent to passing encryptionStrategy AWS_OWNED.

tags.documentation: The tags to associate with the space.

clientToken.documentation: Idempotency token for safe retries. Repeated requests with the same token return the original result instead of creating a duplicate.

name.documentation: The name of the view. Must begin with the "view." prefix. View names must be unique within the account and region.

definition.documentation: The SQL query that defines the view.

clientToken.documentation: Idempotency token for safe retries. Retrying with the same token returns the original view instead of creating a duplicate.

name.documentation: The name of the view.

definition.documentation: The SQL query that defines the view.

createdAt.documentation: The timestamp when the view was created.

updatedAt.documentation: The timestamp when the view was last updated.

DashboardId.documentation: Dashboard identifier — a lowercase v4 UUID assigned when the dashboard is created.

DeepLinkCode.documentation: A one-time deep-link code exchanged for a domain-scoped session. Sensitive: it can be redeemed for a session token, so it is redacted from request logs and CloudTrail.

DeepLinkUrl.documentation: A deep-link URL that embeds the one-time deep-link code. Sensitive: it carries the same redeemable code, so it is redacted from request logs and CloudTrail.

grantId.documentation: The ID of the access grant to delete.

profileId.documentation: The unique ID of the access profile to delete.

grantId.documentation: The ID of the access grant to delete.

domainId.documentation: The ID of the organization domain to delete.
The unique ID of the domain to delete.

identifier.documentation: Identifies the integration to delete — exactly one of integrationId, integrationArn, or integrationName.

DeleteIntegrationOutput.documentation: The response from deleting an integration. Empty by contract — a successful call indicates the deletion was accepted (DeleteIntegration is idempotent).

spaceId.documentation: The unique ID of the space to delete.

name.documentation: The name of the view to delete.

domainId.documentation: The unique ID of the domain.

domainArn.documentation: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the domain.

name.documentation: A name that identifies the domain.

identityProviders.documentation: The identity providers configured for the domain.

domainEndpointUrl.documentation: The HTTPS endpoint URL for accessing the domain.

customEndpointUrls.documentation: Additional endpoint URLs derived from the domain name.

identityCenterApplicationArn.documentation: The ARN of the Identity Center application. Absent for IAM-only domains.

region.documentation: The Region where this domain was created.

createdAt.documentation: The timestamp when the domain was created.

updatedAt.documentation: The timestamp when the domain was last updated.

DomainId.documentation: Domain identifier in "d-{base36}" format, e.g. "d-5h2neqbcpc4sk6gswog". Minted by the backend as "d-" + base36(UUID) — at most "d-" plus 25 chars. Note: not a bare UUID (unlike space/grant ids), so a UUID pattern would wrongly reject valid domain ids.

domainId.documentation: The unique ID of the domain.

domainArn.documentation: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the domain.

name.documentation: A name that identifies the domain.

identityCenterInstanceArn.documentation: Identity Center instance ARN configured for the domain. Absent for IAM-only domains.

region.documentation: The Region where this domain was created.

createdAt.documentation: The timestamp when the domain was created.

updatedAt.documentation: The timestamp when the domain was last updated.

edgeId.documentation: The unique identifier of the edge within the context graph.

from.documentation: The node identifier the edge originates from.

to.documentation: The node identifier the edge points to.

edgeType.documentation: The kind of relationship the edge represents.

edgeProperties.documentation: Attributes promoted out of the flat attribute map onto typed members. Which members are present depends on what produced the edge.

telemetryAttributes.documentation: The edge's OpenTelemetry (OTel) attributes, as emitted by telemetry. A key promoted onto an edgeProperties member is removed here, so no value appears twice.

signalTypes.documentation: The kinds of telemetry signal observed on this edge.

sources.documentation: The discovery sources that contributed this edge.

metadata.documentation: Descriptive metadata about the edge. Present only when the request sets includeMetadata.

firstObservedAt.documentation: When this edge was first observed (UTC), at minute granularity. For an edge that merged across sources, this is the earliest value any source reported.

lastObservedAt.documentation: When this edge was most recently observed (UTC), at minute granularity. For an edge that merged across sources, this is the latest value any source reported.

Edge.documentation: A directed edge in the context graph connecting two nodes.

edgeId.documentation: Match only the edge with this identifier.

from.documentation: Match only edges originating from this node identifier.

to.documentation: Match only edges pointing to this node identifier.

edgeType.documentation: Match only edges of this relationship kind.

operations.documentation: Match edges carrying any of these operations.

telemetryAttributes.documentation: Match edges by their OpenTelemetry (OTel) telemetry attributes. Not yet enforced: currently accepted but ignored (does not filter), matching nodeFilters.telemetryAttributes.

sources.documentation: Match edges contributed by any of these discovery sources.

EdgeFilters.documentation: Criteria for filtering edges in a context graph query.

EdgeList.documentation: List of context graph edges returned by GetContextGraph. Bounded to allow up to maxResults nodes each with up to maxEdgesPerNode edges, with a practical upper cap to guarantee predictable response sizes.

protocol.documentation: The IANA protocol name for the observed network traffic, such as "tcp".

sourcePort.documentation: The source port of the observed traffic. May be a placeholder when the port is unknown.

destinationPort.documentation: The destination port of the observed traffic. May be a placeholder when the port is unknown.

blocked.documentation: Whether the observed network flow was denied. Absent means the edge was not derived from network flow data, which is not the same as allowed.

errorCode.documentation: The error code returned when the call was attempted and refused. Its presence means the edge exists but the dependency is failing.

httpStatusCode.documentation: The HTTP status code observed on the request. Distinct from errorCode.

httpMethod.documentation: The HTTP method observed on the request.

serviceInitiated.documentation: Whether the caller was an AWS service principal rather than a user or role. Absent means the edge was not derived from a source that reports it.

trafficStats.documentation: Traffic counters accumulated over the edge's observation window.

EdgeProperties.documentation: Edge attributes promoted out of the flat attribute map onto typed members. Which members are present depends entirely on what produced the edge, so most edges carry only a few of them.

flows.documentation: Total network flows observed across the edge.

EdgeTrafficStats.documentation: Additive traffic counters accumulated over an edge's observation window. Which counters are populated depends on what produced the edge.

encryptionStrategy.documentation: Which kind of key to use. Required.

kmsKeyArn.documentation: Customer managed KMS key ARN. Required when encryptionStrategy is CUSTOMER_MANAGED, and must be omitted when it is AWS_OWNED. Must be a symmetric ENCRYPT_DECRYPT key in the caller's account and region.

EncryptionConfiguration.documentation:
How a resource's data at rest is encrypted.

kmsKeyArn is required when encryptionStrategy is CUSTOMER_MANAGED and must be absent when it is AWS_OWNED; a mismatch is a ValidationException rather than a silently ignored field, so a caller that selects AWS_OWNED while still passing a key learns that the key was not applied.

EncryptionStrategy.documentation: Which kind of KMS key protects a resource's data at rest.

name.documentation: The name of the field. Field names are case-sensitive and must be used exactly as returned when referencing them in query expressions.

profileId.documentation: The unique ID of the access profile.

maxEdgesPerNode.documentation: The maximum number of edges to return per node, bounding the fan-out of a densely connected node.

includeMetadata.documentation: Whether to return the metadata block, semantics included, on each node and edge. Off by default because it costs an extra lookup per returned node.

KmsKeyArn.documentation: KMS key ARN — must be a full key ARN (not an alias).

LogMetadata.documentation: One LOGS query selector block on a node. The attributes map's keys are AND'd; each selects with col = value. Deliberately RAW/un-normalized so the selector matches the store, not the node's merged identity.

LogMetadataAttributeMap.documentation: One LOGS query-selector block: EXACT store column -> raw SCALAR value (mirroring the scalar MetadataAttributeMap). Keyed by the store column that carries the value (e.g. resource.attributes['service.name'], attributes['aws.local.service'], @logGroupName) so the selector matches the emitted signal. A dimension seen under several values (a service under two namespaces, several log groups) becomes several blocks with the same columns and different values, which the console ORs. Dedicated to the LOGS selector so its cap evolves independently of the metric attribute map and the TRACES map. Selector caps are deliberately DISTINCT from the metric caps.

LogMetadataList.documentation: Per-node log query selectors; the list ORs across blocks (e.g. an OTLP block vs a CloudWatch- VENDED block). Bound is a payload cap, not a selection rule.

semantics.documentation: Semantic description of the node. Absent on an edge, because semantics describe a service rather than a relationship.

logs.documentation: Per-signal LOGS query selectors: a LIST of blocks the console ORs, each an AND of exact store column -> raw values. Node-level (edges carry only traces). Populated when the request sets includeMetadata; derived labels (logSourceType) are added by the service projection, not stored here.

traces.documentation: Per-signal TRACES query selectors (same block shape as logs). Present on both node and edge metadata. serviceName is derived at the service projection, not stored here.

Metadata.documentation: Descriptive information about a context graph node or edge, as opposed to its identity and structure. Returned only when the request sets includeMetadata.

MetadataAttributeMap.documentation: Per-metric qualifying attributes carried on MetricMetadata. A dedicated shape (not the shared IntelligenceAttributeMap) so its length cap can be tuned independently.

name.documentation: The metric name as emitted, such as "Duration".

namespace.documentation: DEPRECATED: read attributes["service.namespace"] instead. Retained (deprecated) for backward compatibility with existing consumers; will be removed once they migrate. The logical service grouping the metric belongs to.
namespace.deprecatedMessage: Use attributes['service.namespace']; retained for backward compatibility.

preferredStat.documentation: The statistic to chart or alarm on, such as "p99" or "Sum". Free-form and frequently absent.

metricType.documentation: OTel metric kind: "gauge", "sum", "histogram", "exponential_histogram", or "summary" (CloudWatch-vended metrics carry the same kinds). Absent when the producer did not report one.

attributes.documentation: Per-metric qualifying attributes the console uses to query this metric's telemetry. These are the RAW, store-matching values keyed by their OTel names ("service.name", "service.namespace", "cloud.provider", "cloud.account.id", "cloud.region", "instrumentation_scope") — deliberately NOT the node's normalized/merged identity, so the query selectors match the emitted series. A merged node can carry different values per metric, which is why they live here rather than on the node.

semantics.documentation: What the metric means and the unit it is reported in.

MetricMetadata.documentation: A single metric observed on a context graph node.

MetricMetadataList.documentation: Metrics observed on a context graph node. When more are observed than the cap, the backend keeps RED/OTel-semconv names (http/rpc server+client, span-metrics) ahead of the alphabetical remainder, so the metrics the console charts survive. Must match the backend MetricMetadataList cap or entries the backend kept get re-truncated here at the frontend boundary.

description.documentation: Human-readable description of what the metric measures.

unit.documentation: The unit the metric is reported in.

MetricSemantics.documentation: The meaning and unit of a single metric.

NextToken.documentation: A token to retrieve the next page of results.

treatAs.documentation: The state to report when an evaluation produces no data.

NoData.documentation: Configures how the alert reacts when an evaluation produces no data. {@code treatAs} carries the resulting state; defaults to {@code NODATA} when omitted.

nodeId.documentation: The unique identifier of the node within the context graph.

nodeType.documentation: Whether the node is a service, a resource, or a remote service.

name.documentation: The primary display name of the node.

alternateNames.documentation: Other names this node was observed under. A node that merged across sources reports one resolved name, and the names it was merged away from appear here.

tags.documentation: The tags observed on the underlying resource.

nodeProperties.documentation: Identity attributes promoted out of the flat attribute map onto typed members.

telemetryAttributes.documentation: The node's OpenTelemetry (OTel) attributes, as emitted by telemetry — the raw values, as opposed to the normalized nodeProperties. A key promoted onto a nodeProperties member is removed here, so no value appears twice.

operationDetails.documentation: The operations observed on this node, keyed by operation name. Each value lists the dimension sets that identify the metric series for that operation.

signalTypes.documentation: The kinds of telemetry signal observed on this node.

sources.documentation: The discovery sources that contributed this node.

metadata.documentation: Descriptive metadata about the node. Present only when the request sets includeMetadata.

firstObservedAt.documentation: When this node was first observed (UTC), at minute granularity. For a node that merged across sources, this is the earliest value any source reported.

lastObservedAt.documentation: When this node was most recently observed (UTC), at minute granularity. For a node that merged across sources, this is the latest value any source reported.

edges.documentation: Outbound edges originating from this node. Each edge carries its from.

Node.documentation: A node in the context graph representing a service, resource, or remote service.

NodeCategory.documentation: Coarse classification of what a node is. Orthogonal to NodeType, which says whether the node is a service, a resource, or a remote service. Absent on most nodes today because few producers emit the source attribute.

NodeCategorySet.documentation: Set of node categories to filter a context graph query by.

nodeId.documentation: Match only the node with this identifier.

name.documentation: Match only nodes with this name.

tags.documentation: Match nodes by the tags on the underlying resource.

telemetryAttributes.documentation: Match nodes by their OpenTelemetry (OTel) telemetry attributes.

region.documentation: Match nodes in any of these regions.

cloudProvider.documentation: Match nodes on any of these cloud providers.

sourceAccountId.documentation: Match nodes discovered from telemetry produced by any of these accounts.

namespace.documentation: Match nodes in any of these logical service groupings.

category.documentation: Match nodes of any of these categories.

stage.documentation: Match nodes observed in any of these deployment environments.

sources.documentation: Match nodes contributed by any of these discovery sources.

NodeFilters.documentation: Criteria for selecting nodes in a context graph query.

NodeList.documentation: List of context graph nodes returned by GetContextGraph. Bounded to match GetContextGraphInput.maxResults cap.

region.documentation: The region the node runs in. Falls back to the region the telemetry was ingested from when the node does not report one.

cloudProvider.documentation: The cloud provider hosting the node, resolved from the reported provider, platform, or vendor namespace, and defaulting to "aws".

sourceAccountId.documentation: The account that produced the telemetry this node was discovered from.

namespace.documentation: The logical service grouping the node belongs to. This is not a metric namespace.

category.documentation: What kind of thing the node is, coarser than nodeType.

stage.documentation: The node's deployment environment. A node may be observed in several; this is the highest-precedence one. Match any of them with NodeFilters.stage.

NodeProperties.documentation: Node identity attributes promoted out of the flat attribute map onto typed members. The first four are part of the node's merge key, so a node that merged across sources reports one resolved value for each.

language.documentation: The primary programming language the service is written in.

framework.documentation: The application framework the service is built on.

kind.documentation: The kind of workload the service is.

repository.documentation: The source repository the service is built from.

NodeSemantics.documentation: Semantic description of the service a context graph node represents.

trigger.documentation: The conditions that trigger this notification rule.

target.documentation: The destination for notifications from this rule.

NotificationRule.documentation: Single notification rule: which transitions trigger this rule and where the resulting notification should be sent.

NotificationRuleList.documentation: List of notification rules. On UpdateAlert an omitted list leaves the stored rules unchanged, while an empty list clears them all (see notificationRules).

arn.documentation: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the notification target. For {@code slack} and {@code pagerduty}, an integration ARN as returned by {@code ListIntegrations}.

NotificationTargetMetadataMap.documentation: Map of target-specific metadata keys to values.

stateValues.documentation: Alert state(s) that trigger this rule. Empty / omitted = any state.

NotificationTrigger.documentation: Trigger conditions for a notification rule. {@code stateValues} entries combine with OR semantics; empty / omitted = any state.

clientId.documentation: The OAuth 2.0 client identifier registered with the external system.

clientSecret.documentation: The OAuth 2.0 client secret that pairs with the client identifier.

providerId.documentation: The identifier of the OAuth provider that issued the client credentials.

OAuthClientCredential.documentation: Credentials for an OAuth 2.0 client-credentials grant used to authenticate an integration with its external system.

authCode.documentation: The OAuth 2.0 authorization code returned by the external system's authorization endpoint.

OAuthCodeCredential.documentation: Credentials for an OAuth 2.0 authorization-code grant, supplied when completing the authorization of an integration.

PaginationToken.documentation: Pagination token for context graph and insights.

partialResultsDetected.documentation: True when the query returned partial results (some data could not be read).

PartialResults.documentation: Indicates whether a query returned partial results.

PrincipalId.documentation:
Principal receiving a grant. One field spans every AccessGrantPrincipalType: an IAM principal ARN (IAM_USER / IAM_ROLE / IAM_ROOT), an IdC UUID (IDC_USER / IDC_GROUP), or a service-defined id for ACCESS_PROFILE, ALERT, or AGENT. Must begin with an alphanumeric character.

Set to the reserved value ALL (case-sensitive) to apply the grant to every ALERT principal in the space. ALL is supported only for the ALERT principal type, and only on CUSTOM grants whose single action is AssumeAccessProfile.

principalType.documentation: Whether the principal is a user or a group.

userName.documentation: The user name of the principal. Present for users only.

removeKmsKey.documentation: Set to true to disassociate the configured KMS key. Mutually exclusive with kmsKeyArn; the service returns ValidationException if both are provided.

recordsMatched.documentation: The number of records that matched the query criteria.

partialResults.documentation: Information about whether the query returned partial results.

ResourceArnList.documentation: List of resource ARNs or ARN patterns.

resourceType.documentation: The type of the resource that could not be found. Not always present.

resourceId.documentation: The identifier of the resource that could not be found. Not always present.

errorCode.documentation: The error code associated with the failure.

resourceArns.documentation: Specific resource ARNs or ARN patterns. When set, actions are limited to these resources. When absent, defaults to "*".

tags.documentation: Tag-based conditions for dynamic resource scoping. Access applies only to resources carrying all of the specified tag key/value pairs.

signalTypes.documentation: Signal types this scope's row filtering applies to. Required when rowScopeGroups is set.

rowScopeGroups.documentation:
Row-level filters for this scope, as an OR of AND-groups: a row is visible when it matches every filter in any one group. Requires signalTypes.

Row filters are additive across a principal's matching grants. A signal type with no matching group is unrestricted, and when rowScopeGroups is omitted all rows are visible for all signal types.

ResourceScope.documentation: A single resource scope entry within an AccessGrant. Associates a resource type with optional ARN patterns, tag conditions, and row-level filters.

ResourceScopeTagMap.documentation: Map of tag keys to values for resource scoping.

operator.documentation: Match operator applied to this filter's values.

values.documentation: The values the field is matched against.

RowScope.documentation: A single additive row-level filter on an AccessGrant. A row is visible when its value for the given field matches the filter's values. Row filters are additive: the visible rows are the union of all row filters across a principal's matching grants.

RowScopeGroup.documentation: A group of row filters that must all match. A row satisfies the group only when it matches every filter in it.

RowScopeGroupList.documentation: Row filters as an OR of one or more RowScopeGroups: a row is visible when it matches every filter in any one group. Row filters remain additive across a principal's matching grants.

RowScopeOperator.documentation: Match operator for a row-scope filter. Only IN is supported.

RowScopeValue.documentation: A single allowlist value for a RowScope field.

RowScopeValueList.documentation: The values for a single RowScope field. Duplicates are not permitted.

Rule.documentation:
Top-level rule definition.

{@code telemetryRule} members are optional at the Smithy level to support PATCH semantics on UpdateAlert (send only the sub-blocks you want to change). On CreateAlert, presence is enforced by the service-side validator.

Scope.documentation: Whether an integration is account-scoped (customer-created) or organization-scoped (created by an org-enablement rule on behalf of the destination account). Mirrors the {@code Scope} discriminator used by CloudWatch Centralization / Observability Admin.

ScopedActionName.documentation: A single scoped action in "vendor-code:Action" form (e.g. "bedrock:InvokeModel"). Wildcards are not permitted.

ScopedActionNameList.documentation: The actions for a ScopedActions entry (1-50 entries), each "vendor-code:Action".

resources.documentation: Optional resource scopes constraining these actions to specific resources.

contextConditions.documentation: Optional context conditions for fine-grained access control on these actions.

ScopedActions.documentation: A group of actions within an access grant, together with the resource scopes and context conditions that apply to exactly those actions.

ScopedActionsList.documentation: Groups of scoped actions within an access grant.

domainId.documentation: The ID of the domain to search within.

searchQuery.documentation: A search term to match against user names, display names, and IDs. Pass * to list all principals. Maximum 128 characters.

maxResults.documentation: The maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 10. Valid only when searchQuery is *; other searches reject this parameter and return at most 10 results.

nextToken.documentation: A token to retrieve the next page of results. Valid only when searchQuery is *; other searches do not paginate and reject this parameter. Tokens expire after 24 hours.

SearchPrincipalsNextToken.documentation: SearchPrincipals nextToken. Uncapped — wraps two Identity Store tokens (up to 65,535 chars each) inside a KMS-encrypted envelope.

nextToken.documentation: A token to retrieve the next page of results, or null if there are no more results.

createdAt.documentation: The timestamp when the session was created.

lastActivityAt.documentation: The timestamp of the most recent activity in the session.

sessionName.documentation: The human-readable name of the session. Names under /aws/ are reserved for service integrations.

SessionSummary.documentation: Summary information about a query session, including its identifier, name, and activity timestamps.

SessionToken.documentation: A session token (IdC or deep-link scoped). Sensitive: carries a bearer credential, so it is redacted from request logs and CloudTrail requestParameters.

SignalType.documentation: Telemetry signal type that row-scoped access control applies to.

SignalTypeList.documentation: The set of telemetry signal types a row scope applies to.

Source.documentation: Data source enum for context graph queries.

name.documentation: A name that identifies the space.

spaceArn.documentation: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the space.

domainArn.documentation: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the domain the space belongs to. Absent when the space is not associated with a domain, so callers must tolerate its absence.

region.documentation: The region where this space was created.

ownerAccountId.documentation: AWS account ID that owns this space.

dataAccessRoleArn.documentation: The ARN of the IAM role used for data access.

createdAt.documentation: The timestamp when the space was created.

updatedAt.documentation: The timestamp when the space was last updated.

agentCoreEvaluationRoleArn.documentation: The ARN of the IAM role used by AgentCore online evaluation. Absent when the space was created without one.

encryptionConfiguration.documentation: How the space's data at rest is encrypted. Always populated: a space with no customer managed key reports encryptionStrategy AWS_OWNED and no kmsKeyArn.

spaceId.documentation: The ID of an existing space to return credentials for.

domainId.documentation: The ID of the domain, when returning credentials for a target account that does not yet have a space.

targetAccountId.documentation: The ID of the target member account. Required when domainId is set.

SpaceCredentialRequestContext.documentation: Identifies what the credentials are for: either an existing space, or a target account in a domain. Specify spaceId, or both domainId and targetAccountId.

SpaceId.documentation: Space identifier — a v4 UUID minted by the backend.

name.documentation: A name that identifies the space.

spaceArn.documentation: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the space.

domainArn.documentation: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the domain the space belongs to. Absent when the space is not associated with a domain, so callers must tolerate its absence.

region.documentation: The region where this space was created.

ownerAccountId.documentation: AWS account ID that owns this space.

createdAt.documentation: The timestamp when the space was created.

updatedAt.documentation: The timestamp when the space was last updated.

SpaceSummary.documentation: Summary of a space. Call GetSpace for the full space.

sessionName.documentation: A human-readable name for the session. Names under /aws/ are reserved for service integrations.

TagKey.documentation: Tag key. Must be non-empty; AWS-standard maximum length. Constraining the key (rather than a bare String) rejects empty-key payloads at the edge with a 400 ValidationException instead of faulting downstream as a 500.

TagValue.documentation: Tag value. AWS-standard maximum length; may be empty.

condition.documentation: The condition that determines when the alert fires.

noData.documentation: How the alert behaves when a query produces no data.

TelemetryRule.documentation: Telemetry-based rule: what to query, how to evaluate the result, what condition makes it fire, and what to do on missing data.

ThresholdMode.documentation: How a threshold is applied to query results.

retryAfterSeconds.documentation: The number of seconds to wait before retrying the request. Not always present.

ThrottlingException.documentation: The request was throttled due to exceeding the allowed request rate.

TraceMetadata.documentation: One TRACES query selector block on a node/edge (see LogMetadata).

TraceMetadataAttributeMap.documentation: TRACES counterpart of LogMetadataAttributeMap — a dedicated per-signal map so the two evolve independently (same scalar shape and cap today).

TraceMetadataList.documentation: Per-node/per-edge trace query selectors; the list ORs across blocks. Bound is a payload cap.

profileId.documentation: The unique ID of the access profile to update.

name.documentation: A new name for the access profile. Omit to leave unchanged.

description.documentation: A new description of the access profile. Omit to leave unchanged.

profileId.documentation: The ID of the access profile associated with the alert.

name.documentation: A new display name for the alert. Omit to leave the name unchanged (apply-if-present / PATCH). Same constraints as CreateAlert.name; the name is not the alert's identity, so a rename never changes the alertId.

description.documentation: A new description of the alert. Omit to leave unchanged.

rule.documentation: The rule that defines how the alert is evaluated. Omit to leave unchanged. Each sub-block is replaced whole when present: {@code query}, {@code condition}, {@code evaluation} and {@code noData} are applied only when supplied, and within a supplied block an omitted optional member is cleared to unset (null/absent) rather than preserved from the stored alert or defaulted. See {@link AlertCondition} and {@link AlertEvaluation}.

notificationsEnabled.documentation: Whether actions (notifications) are enabled for this alert. Omitted = leave existing value unchanged.

notificationRules.documentation: Replaces the entire notification rule list when present; full-replace, not merge. Omitted = leave existing rules unchanged. An empty list clears all rules (the alert keeps evaluating; only notifications stop).

domainId.documentation: The ID of the organization domain to update.

name.documentation: A new name for the organization domain. Omit to leave unchanged. Must be 3-63 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. It must begin and end with a letter or number and cannot contain consecutive hyphens.

identityProviders.documentation: The identity providers to configure for the domain. Omit to leave unchanged.

identityProviderConfiguration.documentation: Identity provider configuration for the domain. Omit to leave unchanged.

organizationDomain.documentation: The details of the updated organization domain.

domainId.documentation: The unique ID of the domain to update.

name.documentation: A new name for the domain. Omit to leave unchanged. Must be 3-63 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. It must begin and end with a letter or number and cannot contain consecutive hyphens.

identityProviders.documentation: The identity providers to configure for the domain.

identifier.documentation: Identifies the integration to update — exactly one of integrationId, integrationArn, or integrationName.

credential.documentation: The replacement credential used to authenticate with the provider.

integrationAttributes.documentation: The provider-specific attributes to associate with the integration.

roleArn.documentation: The Amazon Resource Name of the IAM role assumed to access the integration.

UpdateIntegrationInput.documentation: The request for updating an existing integration.

integration.documentation: The details of the updated integration. This is the same object returned by GetIntegration and CreateIntegration. Populated on a successful update; absent only if the post-update read-back of the resource did not complete.

body.documentation: The new dashboard definition, as a JSON document. Maximum 1 MiB. Omit to leave unchanged.

name.documentation: A new name for the dashboard. Omit to leave unchanged.

description.documentation: A new description of the dashboard. Omit to leave unchanged.

spaceId.documentation: The unique ID of the space to update.

name.documentation: A new name for the space. Omit to leave unchanged. Must be 3-64 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. It must begin and end with a letter or number and cannot contain consecutive hyphens.

encryptionConfiguration.documentation: How to encrypt the space's data at rest. Omit to leave encryption unchanged. Pass encryptionStrategy AWS_OWNED to stop using a customer managed key and revert to service owned encryption.

name.documentation: The name of the view to update.

definition.documentation: The new SQL query that defines the view. Omit to leave unchanged.

description.documentation: The new description of the view. Omit to leave unchanged.

name.documentation: The name of the view.

definition.documentation: The SQL query that defines the view.

createdAt.documentation: The timestamp when the view was created.

updatedAt.documentation: The timestamp when the view was last updated.

errorCode.documentation: The error code associated with the validation failure.

ViewName.documentation: User view name: must start with "view." prefix followed by lowercase alphanumeric, hyphens, and underscores.

name.documentation: The name of the view.

createdAt.documentation: The timestamp when the view was created.

updatedAt.documentation: The timestamp when the view was last updated.

ViewSummary.documentation: Summary information about a view. Does not include the view definition.

documentation: CloudWatch Omni is a unified observability experience built on Amazon CloudWatch. You work in a space, an isolated environment that holds your telemetry and controls who can access it, and your data is stored in the CloudWatch Dataset for correlated analysis of logs, metrics, and traces.
